ownership: CMS states U.S. government works are public domain; do not imply government endorsement.
allowed_use: offline metadata and synthetic selected-field CSV conformance
retention: This prerequisite writes no dataset artifacts. Any future acquired source requires immutable operation-owned retention and reviewed cleanup.
redistribution: Government-data reuse notice is recorded; no public application export is enabled by this prerequisite.
identity: Source facility identifier is not an NPI, canonical organization, verified campus or unique business identity.
temporal: Metadata modified, released and observation times are separate; no facility current-operation status is inferred.
geography: Source address text only; ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate, geocode and governed membership unmeasured.
